name: NICKEL PRATT
note: PRATT ON PROSPERITY (doc 57 D2: 'The first time Thad comes to Prosperity in Act II, Pratt is on it, pulling up the stake: PRA_D2 plays as he arrives'; doc 04 PRA_D2: 'with a stake and a mallet, mid-jump, unhurried about it'). Beside the claim marker with his mallet and a new stake of his own. Once Thad has had it out with him (PRA_D2 option 1) he goes back next door at a walk, mallet in hand (errata 97 D).
walkToNote: Between the claim marker and Pratt, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Pratt.

sprite.frameNote: 0 the mallet resting on the ground · 1 breath (derived) · 2 the mallet on his shoulder · 3 the mallet raised overhead · 4 struck down on the new stake. Every `breakEvery` seconds he drives the stake, or shoulders the mallet (errata 77).
sprite.statureNote: The bigger man: room-25's master drew him 1.05 of Thad; 1.03 keeps him inside the 5% a standing man is held to (tests/scale.test.ts).
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole, his hat excluded: 0.913 of the drawn rest frame, as measured on the rake row of the same sheet (the hat-brim reading is thrown here by the mallet's handle).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 19 (reference/cast-unify-17.txt), full figure, his mallet in every pose so it never appears or vanishes; cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet; its own file.

exit.note: Doc 57 D2 sends him back to his own claim; Pratt's claim is next door, past the creek at the right (errata 97 C).
exit.walkNote: WALK-C (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "Pratt is horrible"): six frames posed on Thad's walk (cast-unify 45), cut by tools/art/walk-c.py; strideRatio MEASURED FROM THESE FRAMES (R5f): the planted foot's travel against the body over a cycle, against the same measure on Thad's walk (whose recorded 0.588 it calibrates); so the cycle advances with the ground he covers and his feet hold it.
